Second, delete the last page of the document.
Third, create a List of Tables from all tables in the document and place it on the document's List of Tables page.
Fourth, adjust the positions and sizes of the tables: place a table on the same page as the text whenever they can fit on one page; if they cannot fit on one page, place the table on a separate page whenever possible.
